label: Purpose and levels
text: ST.O.A4.1 — War as the continuation of policy (M14) [clausewitz-c02], [mao-c06], [wylie-c15], [gray-c01]. The trinity [clausewitz-c03]. Positive and negative purpose [clausewitz-c05]; the object of war [mao-c05]. Strategy as control [wylie-c03], [wylie-c18]; as creating power [freedman-c02]; strategic effect [gray-c03]; nature and character [gray-c04]. The kernel: diagnosis, guiding policy, coherent action [gsbs-c01]. Levels: five levels in two dimensions [luttwak-c17]; the technical level is never autonomous [luttwak-c07]; grand strategy as top floor [luttwak-c14]; one fact valued differently at different levels [luttwak-c16]; tactics and strategy as one continuum [freedman_strategists-c07]. Operational art as campaign design (thin; [luttwak-c09]).

warrant.standard: Argument from definitions, traced to classical texts read in context.
warrant.defeaters: Concept stretching; anachronistic reading of Clausewitz [wylie-c15].
